title: Unsubstantiated Generic Environmental Claim

evidence.snippet: Packaging consists of standard PET plastic (recyclable, non-biodegradable). No EU Ecolabel or ISO 14024 certification attached.

rule: EU Directive 2024/825 (EmpCo) - Annex I, Point 4bis (Generic environmental claims without recognized excellent environmental performance)
risk: Possibly non-compliant with EU EmpCo Directive rules against generic green claims without verifiable certification.
fix: Made with 85% recycled PET plastic packaging, verifiable under ISO 14021 self-declared environmental claims.

title: Unverified 48-Hour Efficacy Claim

evidence.snippet: Corneometer measurements were recorded at T=0, T=8h, and T=24h post-application on 22 subjects.

rule: EU Regulation 655/2013 (Cosmetic Claims Common Criteria) - Point 3 (Evidential Support)
risk: No evidence found for the 48-hour duration; uploaded laboratory dossier only documents testing up to 24 hours.
fix: Clinically tested to provide up to 24 hours of continuous skin hydration.

title: Carbon Neutrality Claim Based on Offsetting
claim: Zero carbon footprint – 100% climate neutral skincare

evidence.snippet: Emissions are compensated via reforestation carbon credits in South America.

rule: EU Directive 2024/825 (EmpCo) - Annex I, Point 4ter (Claims of neutral/positive environmental impact based on greenhouse gas offsetting)
risk: Possibly non-compliant with EmpCo prohibition on claiming a product has a neutral carbon impact based on offsetting schemes outside the product's lifecycle.
fix: We reduce manufacturing emissions by 30% using solar energy and fund verified reforestation projects.

title: Discount Mismatch Between Ad and Landing Page
claim: Flash Sale: Get 50% OFF everything today!

evidence.snippet: Extracted product offer shows MRP 200 RON, Sale Price 160 RON (-20% discount applied at checkout).

rule: EU Directive 2005/29/EC - Art. 6 (Misleading Actions regarding price or the manner in which price is calculated)
risk: Significant discrepancy detected between advertised discount (-50%) and actual landing page price reduction (-20%).
fix: Flash Sale: Get 20% OFF sitewide today (or update landing page pricing tier to match the 50% promotional offer).

title: Contradictory Free Shipping Condition
claim: Free express delivery on all orders, no minimum spend!

evidence.snippet: Standard shipping: 19.99 RON. Free delivery applies only to orders over 250 RON.

rule: EU Directive 2005/29/EC - Art. 7 (Misleading Omissions of material delivery charges)
risk: Ad promises unconditional free delivery, while the landing page imposes a 250 RON threshold.
fix: Free express delivery on all orders over 250 RON (19.99 RON flat rate under 250 RON).

title: Ingredient 'Free-From' Inconsistency

evidence.source: INCI List on Product Page & Technical Sheet
evidence.snippet: Ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Parfum (Fragrance), Linalool, Limonene.

rule: EU Regulation 655/2013 - Annex III ('Free from' claims & Fairness Criteria)
risk: Product INCI declaration lists 'Parfum', 'Linalool', and 'Limonene', which contradicts the 'Fragrance-Free' claim.
fix: Formulated with mild botanical scent; dermatologically tested for normal to combination skin.

title: Primary 'Buy Now' CTA Leads to HTTP 404
claim: Shop the Bundle Now – Instant Checkout

evidence.snippet: Playwright link check returned HTTP Status 404 (Not Found) on primary hero CTA button.

rule: Conversion & Technical Integrity Standard - Broken Funnel Path
risk: 100% of paid traffic clicking the primary bundle button hits a dead end, resulting in immediate ad budget waste.
fix: Update CTA href attribute to point to the active checkout URL (/cart/add?id=bundle-2026).

title: Slow Mobile Largest Contentful Paint (LCP > 4.8s)

evidence.snippet: LCP measured at 4.85s due to unoptimized 6.4MB PNG hero background image. Total Blocking Time: 620ms.

rule: Core Web Vitals - Mobile LCP Threshold (< 2.5s recommended)
risk: High mobile bounce risk before the landing page finishes rendering the main offer.
fix: Convert hero image to WebP/AVIF (< 250KB) and add fetchpriority='high' to the primary product image.

title: Insufficient Text Contrast on Discount Disclaimer
claim: *Offer subject to terms and seasonal availability

evidence.snippet:
Element

has a contrast ratio of 1.62:1 (Expected minimum 4.5:1).

rule: WCAG 2.1 AA - Success Criterion 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (automated checks only)
risk: Key promotional conditions are nearly illegible for users with low vision or on mobile screens outdoors.
fix: Change text color class from text-gray-300 (#D1D5DB) to text-slate-700 (#334155) to achieve a 7.4:1 contrast ratio.

title: Missing Accessible Name on Icon-Only Cart Buttons

evidence.source: axe-core Rule: button-name & image-alt (automated checks only)
evidence.snippet: 3 <button> elements in product grid contain only an SVG icon without aria-label or screen-reader text.

rule: WCAG 2.1 A - Success Criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (automated checks only)
risk: Screen reader users cannot identify the action of the purchase buttons, blocking inclusive checkout flows.
fix: Add aria-label='Add HydraGlow Serum to cart' to each icon-only action button.

title: Unverified Scarcity Pressure ('Only 2 Left in Stock!')
claim: Hurry! Only 2 items left in stock at this price!

evidence.snippet: Hardcoded string 'Only 2 left!' in static HTML; schema.org availability is set to 'InStock' with no inventory API call.

rule: EU Directive 2024/825 & Dark Patterns Guidance - Fake Scarcity / Urgency Cues
risk: No evidence found for real-time inventory tracking; static scarcity message may be flagged as manipulative urgency.
fix: Remove hardcoded stock counter or bind the badge dynamically to verified warehouse inventory counts.

title: 'Verified Buyer' Testimonials Without Proof Source

evidence.snippet: Reviews are rendered as static HTML blocks with no link to an independent review platform or verification methodology.

rule: EU Directive 2005/29/EC (Omnibus / EmpCo) - Annex I, Point 23b (Stating reviews are submitted by real consumers without verification)
risk: No evidence found on the page explaining how customer reviews are collected, checked, or verified.
fix: Add a clear disclosure explaining how reviews are authenticated (e.g., via post-purchase order ID links) or link to verified provider.
